title: Elucidation of the acid reactivity of polyhedral orthoformates for the synthesis of carbasugar derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20734-20744
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01049G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kazuki Usuguchi, Akira Takagi, Ippei Takashima, Kensuke Okuda
We present new insights that contribute to the synthesis of carbasugar derivatives by elucidating the acid reactivity of polyhedral orthoformates depending on their geometric isomerism and substituents using DFT calculations.
